flightTracker.invalid: Use a flight number, like AA6 or AAL6.
flightTracker.refreshHelp: Flight data comes from AirLabs and shows the next or current flight of each number. Each lookup counts against the AirLabs plan.
flightTracker.codeFieldHelp: The text or formula field of this table holding each row's full flight code: airline code and number, like WN878 or SWA878.
flightTracker.codeFieldRequired: Choose the field holding the flight numbers.
flightTracker.intervalViewHelp: A flight on screen is looked up again once its data is this old. Each lookup counts against the AirLabs plan.
flightTracker.intervalScheduleHelp: Every flight in the table is looked up again this often, viewed or not. Each lookup counts against the AirLabs plan.
flightTracker.docs: Read only. The live AirLabs data of the flight number in the flight code field: status, airline, departure and arrival (airport, terminal, gate, scheduled, estimated and actual times in the airport's local time and UTC), or null. Keys are always present, null when unknown.
